parts.name: Stone square wall infill
parts.description: A 2 m square masonry panel matching the half-gable rise. Fill wider gable ends, loft walls and short upper bays.

parts.name: Stone half floor
parts.description: A 4 by 2 m slab, 0.25 m deep below its walking surface. Pair panels for a full bay or leave a clear stair opening.

parts.name: Stone flat roof
parts.description: A walkable 4 by 4 m flat masonry roof deck, 0.25 m deep below its top surface. Uses floor placement and stays level when tiled.

parts.name: Stone broad arch wall
parts.description: A standard-height 4 by 3 m masonry wall with a 3.5 m wide opening, spring at 2.25 m and inner crown at 2.75 m. Solid masonry fills above the arch to the level wall top.

parts.name: Stone arched doorway wall
parts.description: A full stone wall with a true semicircular arch and radial stone ring. Fixed empty opening; no door, shutter or glass.

parts.name: Stone arched window wall
parts.description: A full stone wall with a true semicircular arch and radial stone ring. Fixed empty opening; no door, shutter or glass.

parts.name: Open braced timber frame
parts.description: An open 4 m timber bay with two diagonal knee braces and a broad header. Clear central passage; no curved wooden arch or moving parts.
